svg.text: Timing: the same 1 s code with and without fixed release (protocol 9)
A. Release on arrival (positive control, 64 replies): reply time in seconds
B. Fixed release, deadline 10 s (512 code and 512 honest replies): milliseconds after the deadline
In A the server's wait shows directly. In B both bit values land in the same sub-millisecond band; the registered decoder
did not detect the code (book: Measurements, protocol 9). Axis B ends at the 98th percentile.
